text: Nyan Cat held search attention for nine months.
Gangnam Style held it for about four.
Then Harlem Shake broke the rhythm.
Its search attention window shrank to about two to three weeks.
But Coffin Dance kept going, four months.
The content cycle can turn much faster.
One trend becomes a remix, hits saturation, then gets replaced.
Exceptions matter. But attention can still collapse from months into weeks.
